title: pi-claude-bridge
brief: Lets you route Pi's model calls through a Claude subscription ("allow sub usage in pi"). Same cost-saving idea as pi-claude-agent-sdk: agentic coding without per-token API billing.
details: The original Pi extension by Eli Dickinson integrating Claude Code via the Agent SDK (538 stars, 132 forks) — the project that pi-claude-agent-sdk was forked from (itself originally based on Prateek Sunal's claude-agent-sdk-pi). Two features: a provider that runs Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku inside Pi with all tool calls flowing through Pi's TUI, and the opt-in AskClaude tool, which lets Pi's LLM delegate tasks or questions to Claude Code while using another provider ("Ask Claude to plan a fix", "ask claude to poke holes in this theory", "ask an isolated claude to review the implementation"). AskClaude supports read-only, none, or full (read+write+bash) modes, per-call model and thinking-effort selection, and isolated sessions. Model list auto-tracks Pi's Anthropic catalog, 1M context on newer models, and billing currently draws on your regular Pro/Max subscription quota like Claude Code. MIT.
